title: Shinonome Akito — How We Each Spend Our Days Off〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: How We Each Spend Our Days Off（2★）

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go with this set list.
Are we all good with that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! I'm okay with it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm also okay with it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, that settles that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I feel our set list has become really good thanks to the addition of your track, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Totally! It adds such a nice accent.
I can't wait to see how the crowd's gonna react to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm happy that you're saying that, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know I should've said this sooner, but I'm sorry for making it without asking you all first.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not only did it take you all by surprise, but we have to practice even more now after deciding to perform two songs. It seems like such a large burden.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But it's not a burden.
We agreed to perform two songs because we all think that your song is just that amazing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, we sort of already knew that you were working on something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: However, it didn't seem like you were being bothered by anything, and you were doing fine during practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In the end, we figured that there was nothing for us to worry about since you seemed to know what you were doing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And we had a feeling that you'd come talk to us if you needed our help.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting to hear that you were working on your own track.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, sorry about that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll let you all know the next time I do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't have to tell us every single time. Just bring it over for us to listen if you think it's good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And ask me for help if you ever need it. I'll always be willing to help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, what he said!
I'll help too if you ever think you need it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, me too...!
That is, if you think I can help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It could be fun to make a track together down the road.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that does sound fun...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I really wanna hear that song!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A track by you two...
That does sound interesting. I wonder how it'll turn out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not like we've actually decided to make one... But I am looking forward to that prospect.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, what if you two started fighting while making it...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I hope we don't...
Akito, please tell me straight away without hiding it if something is bothering you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. When that happens, Kohane or I will step in to save the day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd appreciate that very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you all going on about...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're just making sure that we're prepared.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
More importantly, we have an event to think about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All good! I'm gonna do mental prep for our rehearsal starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine. In any case, we have a lot of work ahead of us if we plan on singing both our song and Toya's at a high level.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Let's do our best to make our next event one to remember.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Yeah!
